title: الأخلاق والقرارات
subtitle: wish, if only, I'd rather and unreal past
intro: English uses the past tense to talk about things that are not real. I wish I knew is about now. It's time we left is about now. Once you see the pattern, a whole family of structures opens at once.تستعمل الإنجليزيّة صيغة الماضي للحديث عمّا ليس واقعاً. I wish I knew عن الحاضر، وIt's time we left عن الحاضر. وحين ترى النمط تنفتح عائلةٌ كاملة من التراكيب دفعةً واحدة.
goals: I can express regret, preference and criticism precisely
I can discuss dilemmas and moral reasoning
I can use the unreal past across all its structures
I can hear these forms in real conversation

days.title: The unreal past
days.subtitle: wish · if only · I'd rather · it's time · as if

blocks.title: wish: three times, three forms
blocks.html:
About now — wish + past simple
I wish I knew the answer. — I don't
I wish I were braver. — were for all persons in careful English

About the past — wish + past perfect
I wish I had said something. — I didn't, and I regret it

About someone else's behaviour — wish + would
I wish he would stop interrupting. — annoyance, and it is ongoing

⚠️ You cannot say I wish I would … about yourself — use could.ثلاثة أزمنة وثلاث صيغ. وwould لا تُستعمل عن نفسك، بل could.

blocks.title: if only — the emphatic version
blocks.html:
Same grammar as wish, more emotional weight:

If only I had listened. — stronger than I wish I had listened
If only they would answer the phone.

Often left unfinished in speech: If only we'd known … — the silence does the work.

Use it once. Twice is melodrama.النحو نفسه بثقلٍ عاطفيّ أكبر. وتُترك ناقصةً في الكلام غالباً، فيقوم الصمت بالمهمّة.

blocks.title: I'd rather — preference about others
blocks.html:
Same subject → bare infinitive:
I'd rather wait. · I'd rather not say.

Different subject → past tense:
I'd rather you didn't mention it. — about now
I'd rather you hadn't told him. — about the past

I'd rather you didn't is the most polite refusal in English. It is softer than please don't and firmer than maybe not.«I'd rather you didn't» أرقّ رفضٍ في الإنجليزيّة: ألطف من please don't وأحزم من maybe not.

blocks.title: it's time · as if · suppose
blocks.html:
It's time we left. — we haven't, and we should have already
It's high time someone said this. — overdue, slightly critical

He talks as if he knew her. — he doesn't
She looked as though she had been crying.

Suppose we said no. What then? — hypothetical proposal

All of them use a past form for something unreal or overdue. That is the whole system.كلّها تستعمل صيغة الماضي لما هو غير واقعٍ أو متأخّرٌ عن أوانه. هذا هو النظام كلّه.

blocks.title: The Decision Nobody Made
blocks.en:
Most organisational failures are not decisions. They are the absence of one. Nobody chose to ship the faulty part, approve the misleading figure or ignore the complaint. What happened instead is that eleven people each did something small and defensible, and the sum of those eleven acts was a disaster that none of them would have authorised.

This is why if only someone had written it down is the most common sentence in the aftermath of any investigation. Written rules concentrate responsibility. Unwritten norms distribute it until it disappears. A person who signs a form has made a decision; a person who says nothing in a meeting has not, and will be able to say so afterwards with a clear conscience and complete accuracy.

The uncomfortable implication is that good character is not enough. Every individual in these cases can be honest, careful and well-intentioned, and the system can still produce the outcome. I'd rather we designed for the average day than for the heroic one, because the heroic one is rare and the average one is every day.

What actually works is unglamorous: name an owner for each decision, write the reason down, and make it cheap to raise a concern. None of that requires courage. That is precisely the point.
blocks.ar:
معظم إخفاقات المؤسّسات ليست قرارات، بل غياب قرار. فلم يختر أحدٌ أن يشحن القطعة المعيبة، أو يعتمد الرقم المضلّل، أو يتجاهل الشكوى. ما حدث بدل ذلك أنّ أحد عشر شخصاً فعل كلٌّ منهم شيئاً صغيراً قابلاً للدفاع عنه، وكان مجموع تلك الأفعال الأحد عشر كارثةً ما كان أيٌّ منهم ليأذن بها.

ولهذا فإنّ «لو أنّ أحداً كتبه فحسب» هي أكثر الجمل شيوعاً في أعقاب أيّ تحقيق. فالقواعد المكتوبة تركّز المسؤوليّة، والأعراف غير المكتوبة توزّعها حتّى تختفي. من يوقّع استمارةً يكون قد اتّخذ قراراً، ومن يصمت في اجتماعٍ لم يتّخذ قراراً، وسيستطيع قول ذلك لاحقاً بضميرٍ مرتاحٍ ودقّةٍ تامّة.

والتضمين غير المريح أنّ حسن الخُلُق لا يكفي. فكلّ فردٍ في هذه الحالات يمكن أن يكون أميناً وحذراً وحسن النيّة، ويظلّ النظام قادراً على إنتاج النتيجة. وأفضّل أن نصمّم لليوم العاديّ لا لليوم البطوليّ، لأنّ البطوليّ نادر والعاديّ هو كلّ يوم.

وما يفلح فعلاً غير برّاق: سمِّ مالكاً لكلّ قرار، واكتب السبب، واجعل إثارة القلق رخيصة الكلفة. ولا يتطلّب شيءٌ من ذلك شجاعة. وهذا بالضبط هو المقصود.

days.title: Functional language and pronunciation
days.subtitle: Refusing, regretting and taking a position

blocks.title: Refusing without damage
blocks.html:
I'd rather you didn't. — the polite firm refusal
I'm not comfortable with that. — personal, hard to argue with
That's not something I can sign off on. — professional
I'd need that in writing before I could agree. — a refusal shaped as a condition
I'll have to say no on this one.

⚠️ I'm not comfortable with that is very strong in English. It is not about feelings; it signals an ethical line.انتبه: «I'm not comfortable with that» قويّةٌ جدّاً بالإنجليزية — إنّها إشارة إلى خطٍّ أخلاقيّ لا إلى شعور.

blocks.title: Regret without self-destruction
blocks.html:
Proportionate: I wish I'd handled that differently.
Analytical: With hindsight, I'd have escalated earlier.
Owning it: That was my call and it was the wrong one.
Boundaried: I made it with the information I had.

Avoid: I'm so sorry, it was all my fault, I'm terrible at this. In professional English, excessive apology reads as instability, not humility.في الإنجليزيّة المهنيّة يُقرأ الاعتذار المفرط اضطراباً لا تواضعاً. اعترف بدقّةٍ ثمّ حدّد ما ستفعله.

blocks.title: 🚫 لا تقل هذا
blocks.html:
❌ I wish I would know → ✅ I wish I knew
❌ I wish I would have gone → ✅ I wish I had gone
❌ I'd rather to stay → ✅ I'd rather stay
❌ I'd rather you don't → ✅ I'd rather you didn't
❌ It's time we go → ✅ It's time we went
❌ He behaves like he knows everything (formal) → ✅ He behaves as if he knew everything
❌ I regret to do that → ✅ I regret doing that

regret doing = you did it and are sorry. regret to say = you are about to deliver bad news. Two different meanings.regret doing تعني أنّك فعلته وتندم، وregret to say تعني أنّك على وشك نقل خبرٍ سيّئ. معنيان مختلفان تماماً.

blocks.title: The task
blocks.prompt:
Describe a difficult decision you or someone you know faced, in 140–160 words. It must include:

• one wish or if only about the past
• one I'd rather with a different subject
• one it's time or as if
• the trade-off, stated honestly on both sides
• a closing judgement that is not self-punishmentصف قراراً صعباً واجهته أو واجهه من تعرف، في ١٤٠–١٦٠ كلمة، بـwish أو if only عن الماضي، وI'd rather بفاعلٍ مختلف، وit's time أو as if، والمقايضة بأمانةٍ من الجهتين، وحكمٍ ختاميّ ليس جلداً للذات.
phrases: I wish I had … / If only someone had …
I'd rather they had told me …
I made it with the information I had.
blocks.model:
Two years ago I found an error in a report that had already gone to the client. It was small, it favoured us, and correcting it meant admitting that our review process had not caught it.

What was at stake was not the number. It was whether anyone would trust the next report.

I wish I had raised it the same afternoon. Instead I spent a day weighing up how to say it, which made the delay itself part of the problem. My manager reacted as if he had been expecting it, which was somehow worse than anger.

I'd rather they had built a route for this that did not depend on one person's nerve. It's high time most organisations did.

The trade-off was between a short embarrassment and a long erosion. With hindsight, that is not a close call. It only felt like one because I was inside it.
blocks.modelAr:
قبل عامين وجدتُ خطأً في تقريرٍ كان قد أُرسل إلى العميل. كان صغيراً، وفي مصلحتنا، وتصحيحه يعني الاعتراف بأنّ عمليّة مراجعتنا لم تلتقطه.

ما كان على المحكّ ليس الرقم، بل ما إذا كان أحدٌ سيثق بالتقرير التالي.

ليتني أثرتُه في اليوم نفسه. لكنّي أمضيتُ يوماً أوازن كيف أقوله، فصار التأخير نفسه جزءاً من المشكلة. وردّ مديري كأنّه كان يتوقّعه، وهو ما كان أسوأ من الغضب على نحوٍ ما.

وأفضّل لو أنّهم بنوا مساراً لهذا لا يعتمد على جرأة شخصٍ واحد. وقد آن الأوان منذ زمن أن تفعل ذلك معظم المؤسّسات.

كانت المقايضة بين إحراجٍ قصير وتآكلٍ طويل. وبأثر رجعيّ ليست هذه مقارنةً متقاربة. بدت كذلك فقط لأنّي كنتُ داخلها.
checklist: I used 'wish' or 'if only' with a past perfect for the past
I used 'I'd rather' with a different subject and a past form
I used 'it's time' + past, or 'as if' + past
I never wrote 'I wish I would have'
I never wrote "I'd rather you don't"
I stated the trade-off honestly on both sides
I used at least four unit words (at stake, trade-off, weigh up, with hindsight …)
My ending is a judgement, not an apology

أعد نطق «I'd rather ya didn / I wish I'd nown» حتّى تصير تلقائيّة.
